name: Dreamcast
summary: Sega Dreamcast emulator (Flycast WASM) for Brewser
description:
Dreamcast runs Sega Dreamcast software on the Switch through the Brewser runtime, using the Flycast WASM libretro core (Flycast by flyinghead, WebAssembly port and SH4-to-WASM JIT by Nick Somers, GPLv2).

Put your own legally dumped BIOS in bios/ (dc_boot.bin, dc_flash.bin) and zipped disc images in games/, then list them in games/games.json. Without a BIOS the built-in HLE BIOS is used.

  • A/B/X/Y — same positions as the Dreamcast pad
  • ZL/ZR — L/R triggers
  • Minus — Start
  • Plus — quit
_buttonMapping_note: action -> Switch button, per romfs/configs/config.json. Every shell action is unbound so the raw buttons reach the emulator: the shell default binds A=leftClick, B=rightClick, X=addressBar, L=back, R=forward, ZL=bookmark, ZR=home, MINUS=settings, UP/DOWN=scroll, which would swallow most of the Dreamcast pad. exitGame (PLUS) is merged in by the shell as the 'exit' action and stays live.
